purpose: Prove that the GRF04 integer-projection x4 interval used in the V46 HPADJ22 joint route is independent of e over the entire FULL178 admissible domain, so exact joint survivor counting may compute the x4 intersection once per compact (g,d,a,b,c,qA,qBC,parity) cell and multiply by the number of eligible e values.

proof.hpadj16_x4_search_cap: a0_interval uses n_min=8*h with d=2*h, hence n_min=4*d; its right endpoint is strictly below n_min because f0(n_min)>0 is asserted before the right boundary binary search.
proof.resulting_x4_bound: every x4 returned by a0_interval satisfies 0 <= x4 < 4*d
proof.eligible_e_upper_bound: eligible_e uses upper=min(floor(19*d/5),3*d,3*d-(b-c)), hence every eligible e satisfies e<=3*d
proof.strict_relation: therefore x4<4*d<=n for every FULL178 admissible compact cell
proof.consequence: the min(n, raw_hi) cap in the integer-projection x4 interval is never active on any Picard-eligible x4 point
proof.exact_rewrite: count the exact Picard/parity/capacity x4 points in the GRF04 interval once, then multiply by len(eligible_e); do not use min of survivor counts

next_gate.benchmark_target: FULL178 row index 177 resolved from source head as g=1,d=190, historical band7 b=84..96
